A Distinguished Farewell 
A New Chapter of Judicial Service.
It was a privilege to be a part of the farewell and felicitation ceremony organised by RHCLA, Jodhpur, in honour of Hon’ble Dr. Justice P.S. Bhati, on the occasion of His Lordship’s elevation as the Hon’ble Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.

The elevation is a recognition of His Lordship’s distinguished judicial career, marked by wisdom, integrity, constitutional commitment and an unwavering dedication to the cause of justice. 
The occasion was not merely a farewell, but a celebration of a remarkable journey of judicial service and the beginning of an important new chapter.
Heartiest congratulations and my very best wishes to Hon’ble Dr. Justice P.S. Bhati for a distinguished and impactful tenure as the Hon’ble Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
May His Lordship continue to illuminate the path of justice with wisdom, courage and compassion. ⚖️

#Judiciary #Justice #LegalFraternity #Jodhpur #RHCLA #ChiefJustice #HighCourt #JudicialService #ConstitutionalValues
comment: Judicial leadership at the highest level is not only about legal expertise but also about preserving institutional trust, balancing efficiency with fairness, and ensuring that constitutional values remain visible in everyday justice delivery.
